text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the curve of the 4th corner!! 
From here, they're making their surge all 
at once!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, brave hero! Thank you for your 
"swift" running! Thanks to you, I've—)
(SKREEEEEECH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Because this is how I can sever destiny 
once and for all!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And here comes Tanino Gimlet!! Tanino 
Gimlet comes flying from behind!! An 
explosive burst of late speed!! She 
crosses the line!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaaa-hahahahaaa---!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, world?! This! This is 
truly it!! A brand new brilliance of 
ruin!! My true 'speed'!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~~~~... From the very front row... I 
have thoroughly seared it into my 
memory...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Gimlet's the strongest ever--!! 
Congrats on reaching the pinnacle of the 
mile--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, awesome, awesome! This is a 
complete blowout...! As expected of Tanino 
Gimlet...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――So far away...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why is this...? Compared to last year, 
Senpai... feels like she's so far out of 
reach...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because... I was just goofing 
around like a kid until now...? Because 
I'm finally properly watching you run, 
Senpai—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —How's that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Does my appearance—does my stride— harbor 
any fragility that seems on the verge of 
collapse?

Even after conquering a fierce battle, her 
presence remains majestic. The current 
Tanino Gimlet is even more rock-solid than 
last year...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let us advance. To the 
culmination of our rebirth――――the 
'Takarazuka Kinen'!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—O witnesses of my "swiftness"!! True to 
my prior vow, I shall proceed to the next 
battlefield: the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bear witness at this festival where 
sparkling stars gather!! See what 
"strength" is! What chaos and potential 
truly mean!! Witness it all!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —...I can't go on like this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta think about catching up to 
Gim-senpai way more seriously, sincerely, 
and intensely...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I'd just be... admiring her 
from afar... Just some lame Umamusume 
watching senpai from the distance for the 
rest of my life...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll find it at the Takarazuka Kinen...!! 
The path for me to become a totally cool 
Umamusume!!"

The stage to prove a new level of 
"strength," the Takarazuka Kinen, was 
already right around the corner—
